label: Levites
meaning: Members of the tribe of Levi. They cared for the tabernacle and later the temple. The priests came from one Levite family, Aaron’s.

label: Ark
meaning: A chest or a boat. In Genesis it is Noah’s boat. Later it is the gold-covered chest that held the covenant tablets.

label: Covenant
meaning: A binding agreement with promises and duties. In the Bible, God makes covenants with people.

label: Sabbath
meaning: The seventh day of the week, kept as a day of rest.

label: Gentiles
meaning: People of nations other than Israel.

label: Pharisees
meaning: A Jewish group known for careful keeping of the law. Acts 23:8 says they believed in resurrection, angels, and spirits.

label: Sadducees
meaning: A Jewish group close to the high priest (Acts 5:17). Acts 23:8 says they denied resurrection, angels, and spirits.

label: Scribes
meaning: People trained to write and to keep records. In the Gospels, scribes also teach the law.

label: Synagogue
meaning: A local Jewish meeting place for prayer and for reading Scripture.

label: Apostles
meaning: People sent out with a message. In the Gospels the word names twelve whom Jesus chose.

label: Saints
meaning: People set apart as holy. In the letters the word means the believers in a place.

label: Assembly
meaning: A gathering of people. In the New Testament letters it means a group of believers. Many translations say “church.”

label: Tabernacle
meaning: The tent sanctuary Israel carried in the wilderness. Exodus 25–40 describes it.

label: Passover
meaning: A yearly feast that recalls Israel’s escape from Egypt. Exodus 12 gives its first account.

label: Pentecost
meaning: A harvest feast fifty days after Passover (Leviticus 23:15–16). Acts 2 takes place on this day.

label: Baal
meaning: A god worshiped by Israel’s neighbors. The prophets condemn Israel for serving him.

label: Asherah
meaning: A goddess, or a wooden pole set up for her. Deuteronomy 16:21 forbids such poles.

label: Circumcision
meaning: The cutting of the foreskin. Genesis 17 makes it the sign of God’s covenant with Abraham.

label: Atonement
meaning: The covering or removal of guilt, so that people and God are reconciled. Leviticus 16 describes a yearly day for it.

label: Tithe
meaning: A tenth of produce or income given to God.

label: Cherubim
meaning: Winged heavenly beings. Gold figures of them stood over the ark (Exodus 25:18–20).

label: Ephod
meaning: A garment worn by priests. The high priest’s ephod carried a breastplate with twelve stones (Exodus 28).

label: Urim and Thummim
meaning: Objects the high priest used to ask for God’s decision. The Bible does not describe them.

label: Sheol
meaning: The Hebrew name for the place of the dead.

label: Hades
meaning: The Greek name for the place of the dead.

label: Sackcloth
meaning: Rough cloth worn to show grief or repentance.

label: Firstborn
meaning: The oldest child. A firstborn son received a double share of the inheritance (Deuteronomy 21:17).

label: Birthright
meaning: The firstborn son’s right to the larger share of the inheritance.

label: Nazirite
meaning: A person under a special vow. Numbers 6 forbids wine, haircuts, and contact with the dead.

label: Manna
meaning: The food Israel gathered in the wilderness. Exodus 16 describes it.

label: Jubilee
meaning: Every fiftieth year. Land returned to its family, and bound servants went free (Leviticus 25).

label: Redeem
meaning: To buy back a person or property. The word is also used for God’s rescue of people.

label: Kinsman
meaning: A near relative. In Ruth, a near kinsman may buy back a relative’s land.

label: Unclean
meaning: Unfit to take part in worship until a set cleansing is done. Leviticus 11–15 gives the rules.

label: Leprosy
meaning: A skin disease. Leviticus 13 uses the word for several conditions and sets rules for them.

label: Anoint
meaning: To pour oil on a person or thing to set it apart. Kings and priests were anointed.

label: Messiah
meaning: The Hebrew title “anointed one.” John 1:41 gives “Christ” as the same title in Greek.

label: Remnant
meaning: The part of a people that survives a disaster.

label: Zion
meaning: A hill in Jerusalem. The name is also used for the city and its people.

label: Samaritans
meaning: People of Samaria, between Judea and Galilee. John 4:9 says Jews had no dealings with them.

label: Hellenists
meaning: Jews who spoke Greek.

label: Rabbi
meaning: A title of respect for a teacher. John 1:38 gives the meaning as “Teacher.”

label: Parable
meaning: A short story or comparison that teaches a point.

label: Centurion
meaning: A Roman officer in command of about a hundred soldiers.

label: Proconsul
meaning: The Roman governor of a province.

label: Satrap
meaning: A governor of a province in the Persian empire.

label: Eunuch
meaning: A court official. The word often means a man who was castrated.

label: Concubine
meaning: A woman joined to a man’s household with lower standing than a wife.

label: Bondservant
meaning: A slave or bound servant.

label: Cubit
meaning: A length from the elbow to the fingertip, about 46 centimeters.

label: Shekel
meaning: A unit of weight, about 10 grams. Silver was weighed in shekels as money.

label: Talent
meaning: A large unit of weight, about 30 kilograms.

label: Ephah
meaning: A dry measure of about 22 liters.

label: Denarius
meaning: A Roman silver coin. Matthew 20:2 gives it as a worker’s pay for one day.

label: Selah
meaning: A word in the Psalms whose meaning is not known. It may mark a pause.

label: Abba
meaning: An Aramaic word for father. The text gives the translation beside it.

label: Antichrist
meaning: One who opposes Christ. First John 2:22 uses the word for those who deny him.

label: Yeast
meaning: Yeast, or leaven, makes dough rise. Bread made without it is called unleavened.
